correctness.rationale: For each labeled strict profile (6!) is not the sample size: there are (3!)^6=46656 profiles and 12 single-agent adjacent swaps, hence 559872 equally weighted instances. All six perfect matchings are stable precisely when none of nine opposite-side pairs blocks. Independent exact brute force computed the stable-match bitmask for each of 46656 profiles, then intersected it with the stable-match bitmask of each one-swap neighbor: the eight (S,R) cells are 64944,344016,5616,49536,82656,1872,7344,3888, with failure count 70560 and top/bottom 49248/21312. The original source verifier independently uses a local necessary-and-sufficient affected-agent blocking-pair condition. This is a complete finite exhaustive proof for n=3, not an approximation or a general n theorem.
residual_risks: Specialist combinatorial matching profile catalogues or unpublished tables might already contain the joint law.
